routing.task_mode: bounded autofix against an externally adjudicated exact edit specification
allowed_scope: Explicit before/after prose substitutions in existing comments/docstrings
Exact approved declaration-identifier renames and all listed caller updates
excluded_scope: Proof bodies other than mechanical renamed references
Hypotheses, conclusions, constants, domains or definitions
Blueprint completion tags, dependency or scope decisions
Runtime, security, model routing, budgets, credentials, CI or merge controls
Broad cleanup or discovering new repairs
required_validation: Dispatcher-owned fixed file/edit allowlist; no self-classification
Public statement/proof-content equality modulo approved names and comments
Caller and declaration checks; same-or-lower existing proof debt with no new bypasses
Paper integrity audit for any touched paper-linked declaration
Fresh exact-head CI and independent Astra review; normal merge gate
escalation: Ambiguous wording or mathematical meaning: stop and transfer to Astra
Any needed change outside the exact specification: transfer before editing
Any substantive reviewer finding or failed integrity check: Astra, without resetting accumulated budgets

routing.reason: One accepted consolidation is not multiple independent same-class outcomes; other proof artifacts have incomplete acceptance chains, upstream debt, or mathematical rework. No generic proof-capability failure rate is asserted.
Meaning-bearing documentation can change theorem scope or error claims despite green Lean/CI. Source/hypothesis/completion decisions remain Astra.
Useful findings are not evidence of review recall. Sol approval and pipeline green are not independent validation of review accuracy. Required independent review stays Astra.
Two useful confirmations concern different narrow topics; false-negative coverage and multiple accepted examples per narrower diagnostic class are missing.
routing.qualification_boundary: Any future trial may only report reproducible proposed findings, never publish a verdict/status, replace the required reviewer, change code, or adjudicate gates.

routing.reason: Concrete reports/issue artifacts exist, but independent completeness, source correctness and downstream acceptance denominators were not established. Issue count and exit0 are not qualification.
C18 has exact-head CI and independent Astra raw-preservation validation; C19 lacks exact-head statuses and later Astra work must not be transferred backward.

Even accepted bounded technical work does not grant authority over live control planes or their protective tests. Includes authentication, capacity leases, model/effort selection, budget accounting, kill switches, CI/review/merge gates and telemetry integrity.

No Sol mathfix cohort was established. New bridge assumptions, proof debt, source corrections, nontrivial constants and blocked frontier obligations require Astra and the unchanged integrity protocol.
Unknown identity, job class, acceptance chain, scope or effort compatibility fails closed to Astra; a worker cannot expand or self-upgrade its class.
